anomalies.observed: The lower feedback-divider resistor R6 (REG_FB to GND) is 1M3 (1.3 MΩ) while the upper resistor R5 (+5V to REG_FB) is 6k8. SPICE agrees: 'R6 0 REG_FB 1.3Meg'.
anomalies.expected: The spec's own note is Vout = 0.8*(1+R5/R6) and the rail is 5 V, so R6 must be ≈1.3 kΩ (6.8k/5.25). 1.3 MΩ gives Vout ≈ 0.8*(1+6.8k/1.3M) ≈ 0.8 V.
anomalies.impact: The 5 V buck regulates to roughly 0.8 V instead of 5 V, so the servo/PWM power rail and the input to the 3.3 V LDO (REG2.IN) collapse, disabling most of the board.

anomalies.observed: Two distinct 3.3 V nets exist. The LDO output net '+3.3V' carries REG2.OUT/SENSE and all sensor supplies/decoupling (U1–U10, R24/R25/R37/R38, C54–C65); the net '+3V3' carries NAVC1.VBAT, the SWD/connector power pins (SWD1.1, SWD2.1, I2C3_*, UART*_*, RCIN_*, ADC_*, GPS_NAVC1.1) and the I2C pull-ups R9–R14/R28–R31. No component appears on both nets.
anomalies.expected: A single 3V3 rail produced by the LD39200 LDO (REG2) should feed the MCUs and the I2C sensors; the spec states '3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs'.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The +3V3 domain (MCU backup supply, debug/connector power, bus pull-ups) is left without a source, so those nodes are unpowered even though the LDO is present and only drives the '+3.3V' sensor domain.
